beats.text: Five of the greatest love stories ever written.
One. Pride and Prejudice — Austen. Two proud hearts arguing their way into love.
Two. Wuthering Heights — Brontë. A love so wild it refuses to end even at death.
Three. Jane Eyre — Brontë. Love between equals, won only once both are truly free.
Four. Anna Karenina — Tolstoy. Passion and its price, told without a single easy answer.
Five. Romeo and Juliet — Shakespeare. Still the measure every doomed romance is held against.
Love, loss, longing — the classics wrote it first, and best. Full retellings on the channel.

source_note: Full retellings of each are on ReadLark.
